verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
TUKWEYANZA Kitaffe
Ggwe-atukumye-olw'ekisa
Mu budde-obw'emisana,
Ne mu mirimu gyaffe;
Tukuume,Ayi Mutonzi,
Mu nzikiza ya leero.

verse.name: v2
v3
verse.lines:
Naye-okusinga byonna
Tweyanza-okwagala kwo,
Olw'Omwana wo Yesu,
Eyafiira ku muti,
Ku lwaffe aboonoonyi;
Tweyanza nnyo Kitaffe!
